articles.summary: Current source supplies are ideal for pulsed dual magnetron sputtering (DMS). They have the advantage of little to no current rise when an arc occurs, and they enable arc detection by voltage fall due to high incremental impedance.
articles.title: Dual Magnetron Sputtering: Delivering High Power*
